question: Paise kaise send karu? Ravi ko 500 rupees send karna hai.
answer: Home screen pe Send Money button dabayein, recipient ka naam select karein, amount dalein, safety check dekhein aur Confirm Payment dabayein.
simple_answer: Screen par 'Send Money' button dabao. Mujhe batao kise aur kitne paise bhejne hain. Main payment screen par lekar chalunga, fir aap khud button daba kar confirm karna.
steps: Kise bhejna hai uska naam chuno
Details verify karke khud Confirm Payment dabao
safety_warning: Paisa bhejne se pehle recipient ka naam dhyan se check karein.

question: OTP kisi ko dena hai kya? Phone par OTP mang rahe hain.
answer: Khabardaar! Kisi ko bhi apna OTP mat do. SafePay ya bank phone pe kabhi OTP nahi mangte.
simple_answer: BILKUL NAHI! Apna OTP kisi ko mat dena. OTP share karte hi aapke bank se paise chori ho jayenge. Call turant cut kar do.
safety_warning: DANGER: OTP mangne wala fraud hai, paise chura lega.

question: Money epdi send panradhu? Ravi ku 500 send pannanum.
answer: Home screen la Send Money button press pannunga. Ravi name select panni 500 rupees enter pannunga. Details check pannitu Confirm Payment click pannunga.
simple_answer: Blue colour 'Send Money' button press pannunga. Yaaruku evlo anuppanum nu sollunga. Details verify pannitu neengale Confirm Payment click panni mudikalam.
steps: Name check pannitu neengale Confirm Payment click pannunga
safety_warning: Money send pandradhuku munnadi name crt-aa irukaanu check pannunga.

question: OTP share pannalama? Phone la OTP kekuranga.
answer: Koodave koodadhu! Yarukkum OTP share panna koodadhu. Bank or SafePay eppovume phone la OTP keka maattanga.
simple_answer: VENAAM! Yarukkum OTP sollathinga. OTP sonna unga bank la irundhu money thirudiduvanga. Udane call-a cut pannunga.
safety_warning: DANGER: OTP keka yaravathu call panna athu scam!

question: Balance enga irukku? En account la evlo money irukku?
answer: Home screen la mela irukura blue card la unga Available Balance irukum. Eye symbol click panna amount theriyum.
simple_answer: Screen ku mela irukura blue card paarunga. Anga unga bank la irukura balance kaatum.
steps: Mela irukura blue card check pannunga
